data.exact_reserve_text: Claims incurred, net of reinsurance, include adverse prior year development of GBP 12.3m (2021: favourable development of GBP 5.1m). Prior year claims development is analysed by line of business in the table below.

prior_year_events.event_name: Commutation of cession business attaching to the 2018 to 2020 underwriting years
prior_year_events.impact_description: Liability of the Syndicate for future claims ceased following commutation effective 30 November 2022; final premiums and claims on these years were GBP 68.1m and GBP 56.9m respectively.
On an ultimate basis, the 2020 year of account has closed at a profit of GBP 0.7m.

named_events.loss_description: The catastrophe loss ratio for the year has improved, despite exposure to Hurricane Ian.
The syndicate has limited exposure to the conflict in Ukraine, with ultimate losses currently estimated to be GBP 1.5m.

data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2022 were GBP 116.515m and increased to GBP 181.515m at 31 December 2022. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net favourable prior-year development (gross release) of approximately GBP 14.45m across underwriting years 2018-2020. The report separately notes an adverse prior-year development of GBP 12.3m on a net (after reinsurance) basis. Drivers cited include favourable claims development on older years and the wider inflationary environment which has influenced reserving and investment volatility; commutation of cessions for 2018-2020 during the year also materially altered future liabilities for those years.
raw_causal_phrases: The current inflationary environment impacted the Syndicate's results and is reflected in the reserving results

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross prior-year movement (single gross figure) is stated in the reserves movement note; the report gives a net prior-year adverse movement of GBP 12.3m (net of reinsurance). A gross prior-year movement was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (cumulative estimates by underwriting year). The gross triangle formatting in the PDF is somewhat fragmented in places; the triangle-derived gross PYD (-GBP 14.449m) is therefore a calculated value and subject to extraction/formatting uncertainty. Commutation of 2018-2020 cessions during 2022 may materially affect comparisons.
